'''Acid Stream Launchers''' were a type of kinetic-based [[heavy weapon]] commonly used by [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] which projected a high-velocity stream of [[Acid/Legends|acid]]. They were available in a couple different designs, including a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle-like]] configuration, and a more tubular, over the shoulder firing design. Another variant was the [[Devastator Acid Launcher]].

==Description==
The [[Acid/Legends|Acid]] Stream Launcher was a large type of [[heavy weapon]] which projected a high-velocity stream of acid. The weapon was composed of various materials, including units of [[Steel/Legends|steel]], [[Iron/Legends|iron]], [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]], [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]], and [[Carbon/Legends|carbonate]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. It also comprised of a number of different components, including a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] and a heavy weapon core. Optional components included an advance weapon [[Scope/Legends|scope]] and [[Stock/Legends|stock]]. Another variant of the weapon utilized a tubular, over the shoulder design, opposed to the more [[Rifle/Legends|rifle-like]] version.<ref name="AED" /> A similar variant of the Acid Stream Launcher was the [[Devastator Acid Launcher]]. Although similar in appearance, the [[Devastator Acid Launcher]] was considered an energy-based chemical weapon rather than a kinetic-based weapon.<ref name="TOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>

==History==
The weapon saw use during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Commonly used by [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], schematics of the Acid Stream Launcher were available to independent [[weaponsmith]]s and [[Merchant/Legends|munitions traders]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AcidStreamLauncherTube.png|200px|thumb|Over the shoulder tubular variant of the Acid Stream Launcher]]
The [[W:c:swg:Acid Stream Launcher|Acid Stream Launcher]] was included as a [[W:c:swg:Heavy weapon|heavy weapon]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the [[W:c:swg:Weapon|weapon]] could be [[W:c:swg:Crafting|crafted]] by [[W:c:swg:Weaponsmith (pre NGE)|weaponsmiths]] for primary use by players of the [[W:c:swg:Commando (pre-NGE)|commando]] [[W:c:swg:Professions (pre-NGE)|profession]]. The weapon was a tubular, over the shoulder design with a limited number of firing uses.<ref name="AED" /> Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], weaponsmiths were removed,<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> however the weapon could still be constructed by players of the newly created [[W:c:swg:Trader (Munitions)|munitions trader]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]]. Although the weapon was still primarily catered to the newly revamped [[W:c:swg:Commando|commando]] profession, the weapon's strict profession prerequisite was removed. The weapon was also redesigned by the time following the New Game Enhancements to be a free targeting [[W:c:swg:Ranged weapon|ranged weapon]] with a more [[W:c:swg:Rifle|rifle-like]] appearance without any limit on its ammunition. The weapon could be constructed using a number of different [[W:c:swg:Ranged weapon component|components]] and [[W:c:swg:Resource|resources]], including [[W:c:swg:Steel|steel]], [[W:c:swg:Iron|iron]], [[W:c:swg:Polymer|polymer]], [[W:c:swg:Crystalline gemstone|crystalline gemstones]], and [[W:c:swg:Carbonate ore|carbonate ore]].<ref name="AED" /> A couple [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']] reference guides feature the Acid Stream Launcher, including [[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]<ref name="Total">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> and ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' (2005).<ref name="Complete">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
